renderings.kjv: of those things that are shaken

elsewhere.note: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
“Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure…
For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
not to be quickly shaken in your mind, and not be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already…
whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
